RootCause: LSQ::pushRequest calls maybeCorruptPre unconditionally; when the instruction re-enters with translationStarted(), it reuses inst->savedRequest and discards the mutated by-value addr. RegressionRisk: High (ordinal change for A01/A03; PRE family regression)
